scope: Hodram's first Stockholm tavern sailor-recruitment tutorial (SC1 block 134)
profile_note: Fixed-allocation companion layer to the existing Hodram opening probe. States 0x01, 0x10, and 0xFE are reused only within the same SC1 route profile; runtime confirmation remains required.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.context: Hodram greets Gerhard when the player enters Stockholm's tavern.
records.source_meaning: Hodram gives Gerhard a casual greeting.
records.localization_note: Uses Gerhard's established name and a brief, familiar greeting.

records.english: {SPEAKER:10}Perfect timing, Admiral. Some men were wounded, so we're recruiting sailors. Your orders?{PAD}
records.speaker: Gerhard Ardelknatts
records.context: Gerhard reports the crew shortage and asks Hodram how to proceed.
records.source_meaning: Gerhard says the admiral arrived at a good time: casualties have led him to recruit sailors, and he asks for instructions.
records.localization_note: Condenses the polite request into a crisp officer's report without losing the cause or request for orders.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.context: Hodram approves taking direct control of sailor recruitment.
records.localization_note: A natural affirmative that exactly fills the choice record's ten-byte allocation.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.context: Hodram delegates sailor recruitment to Gerhard.
records.source_meaning: Hodram tells Gerhard to take care of it.
records.localization_note: A direct delegation that exactly fills the choice record's fourteen-byte allocation.

records.english: {SPEAKER:10}Buy the patrons a round and men looking for work will gather. Then you can recruit sailors quickly.{PAD}
records.speaker: Gerhard Ardelknatts
records.context: Gerhard explains the tavern's sailor-recruitment mechanic after Hodram chooses to handle it.
records.source_meaning: Gerhard explains that buying drinks attracts people looking for work, after which sailors can be recruited efficiently.
records.localization_note: Localizes the mechanic as buying the patrons a round and keeps the sequence of attracting workers before recruiting them.

records.english: {SPEAKER:FE}Hire extra sailors for boarding. More sailors shorten fleet range, so be careful.{PAD}
records.speaker: Tutorial narration
records.context: The tutorial explains the tradeoff between boarding strength and sailing range.
records.source_meaning: The tutorial advises hiring more sailors for a boarding-focused strategy, but warns that doing so reduces fleet endurance.
records.localization_note: Uses boarding actions and fleet range as concise, player-facing nautical terms.

records.speaker: Gerhard Ardelknatts
records.context: Gerhard accepts the task after Hodram delegates recruitment.
records.source_meaning: Gerhard acknowledges Hodram and asks him to leave the work in Gerhard's hands.
records.localization_note: A confident, natural acknowledgement suitable for Hodram's dependable officer.
